title: feat: add full Inkling through Fireworks
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds canonical model `thinkingmachines/inkling` through Fireworks route `accounts/fireworks/models/inkling` with no aliases or fallback.
- Sets `paidOnly: true`, multiplier `1`, and exact Fireworks text, cached-input, image, audio, and output token costs.
- Supports text, images, audio, tools, JSON, streaming, and mandatory reasoning; converts OpenAI audio input to Fireworks format.
- Verifies direct provider behavior, 10-request burst, local catalogs, permissions, paid-only access, cache reuse, and exact wallet debit.
- Resolves current-main conflicts while preserving the GLM-5.3 Flash Fireworks route test.

gist.headline: Inkling joins the hive
gist.blurb: A new thinker has landed: Inkling now runs through Fireworks with its full multimodal toolkit intact. Give it text, images, audio, tools, or a knotty problem; it has been issued a small desk lamp and mandatory reasoning time.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only canonical model `thinkingmachines/inkling` through Fireworks at `accounts/fireworks/models/inkling`, with text, image, audio, tool, JSON, streaming, mandatory-reasoning support, OpenAI-to-Fireworks audio conversion, and exact per-token pricing.
gist.impact: Paid API users can now call Inkling directly with multimodal inputs and streaming responses, while cached inputs and wallet debits use the configured Fireworks costs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Inkling as a cozy glowing thought-seed or tiny library spirit inside a Fireworks-powered retro terminal, receiving text pages, picture cards, audio cassette-waveforms, JSON scrolls, and tool icons. Polli, wearing round scholar glasses and a tiny scarf, helps feed the terminal's many input channels while code-plants and small flowers grow around its cables, representing a fully multimodal reasoning model joining the API.
